reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to a small business owner-operator in a calm, practical tone without hype. Accurately reflects Bareni's handover principles and respects the zero-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: Logical and immediately understandable, clearly explaining why preventive gates matter more than rollback plans alone in operational workflows.
reasons.actionability: Gives a concrete, sensible exercise for an owner: map three damaging failure modes and place a human approval gate before committing actions.
reasons.factual_grounding: Fully grounded in approved evidence. Accurately frames handover as a no-lock-in policy rather than a warranty, with no invented deployments or capabilities.
